_readme: All GLBs: Y-up, base at y=0, centred on X/Z, largest extent normalised to 1.0 (see bindBBox). Scale in-game = heightM / bindHeight (heightM values are suggestions for a toy-scale plaza; change freely). 'forward' is the direction the front of the model faces in the file (door / face / nose / bow); rotate by the yaw that maps it onto your scene's forward. Extensions: EXT_texture_webp everywhere, plus KHR_mesh_quantization on boat, classroom, tree-cypress and tree-olive. Both are handled natively by THREE.GLTFLoader (no draco/meshopt/KTX2 decoder needed). Every file was loaded with three 0.186.1 GLTFLoader in headless Chromium and passes the Khronos validator with 0 errors. Tripo meshes are visual dressing only: never use them as Rapier colliders (build cuboid colliders from the tower grid instead). Characters: Mixamo humanoid, 65 joints 'mixamorig:*', root node 'Armature', T-pose bind, every clip is stay-in-place (Hips X/Z constant). Clone characters with SkeletonUtils.clone() for crowds.

stork.role: Shula the stork (narrator/mascot, carries the baby bundle)
stork.skeleton: Mixamo humanoid, 65 joints mixamorig:*, root node Armature. Rigged as HUMANOID: the wings ARE the arms (mixamorig:LeftArm/LeftForeArm/LeftHand, same on the right).

procedural.fly/flap: No flying preset exists. Flap = add a sine roll to mixamorig:LeftArm and mixamorig:RightArm on top of idle (about ±35°, 3-4 Hz, opposite signs per side; check the axis in-engine), and move the root along the flight path. cheer also reads as excited wing waving.
procedural.bundle: The baby bundle is not in the mesh. Parent a small cloth-bundle mesh to mixamorig:Head (beak) or mixamorig:RightHand; release it at about 55% of 'bow' (the lowest point of the bow).

stork.notes: x span = spread wings in the T-pose bind (bbox x ±0.5 is wing tip to wing tip; the body is only about 0.3 wide). 'jump' Hips rise 0.295 -> 0.401 bind units: play once (LoopOnce + clampWhenFinished) for a hop/landing, then crossfade to idle. 'bow' leans forward and down (good for dropping the bundle into a floor door). Brown satchel strap across the chest is part of the mesh. greet_04 is a standing raised-wing wave; wave_goodbye_01 was deliberately left out because it crouches.

mayor.role: The mayor (owner of the notice board; reacts to success and collapse)
mayor.skeleton: Mixamo humanoid, 65 joints mixamorig:*, root node Armature

procedural.clipboard: The clipboard did NOT generate in the mesh. Parent a small procedural box (brown board + white sheet) to mixamorig:LeftHand, or to mixamorig:Hips at the left side.
procedural.faint stars: For the gentle 'faint', play 'fall' once with clampWhenFinished (Hips drop to 0.072 bind units, he ends lying on his back), then orbit 3-4 small star/bird sprites above his head. Keep it comic, not injured.

mayor.notes: T-pose bind (x span = arms). Round body, glasses, moustache, navy suit, red ceremonial sash with gold medal (generic, no national symbols). 'fall' and 'frightened' are one-shots.

walker.role: Townsperson for the plaza crowd (walk in, cheer, scatter when the tower wobbles)
walker.skeleton: Mixamo humanoid, 65 joints mixamorig:*, root node Armature

procedural.variety: One mesh for the whole crowd: vary it with a random hue shift on the material (clone the material per instance), scale 0.9-1.1, and random clip start times (action.time = Math.random() * duration).

walker.notes: T-pose bind. Yellow tee, teal vest, green crossbody bag, red sneakers. Generic, no uniform or nationality. 'run' had a constant baked Hips offset (X -0.021, Z +0.405) that was pinned back to the bind values (0.002, 0.002) in assets-src/tools/pin-hips.mjs, so it is now stay-in-place like the others.

classroom.notes: Honey-limestone gable school house, red tile roof, small bell in the gable, two arched windows, turquoise arched door at +Z, potted plants. QUIRK: a small flag pole with a PLAIN blue flag (no emblem) sits on the roof ridge. It is not a national flag, but if you want zero flags, cover it with a decal/roof prop or pick workplace-bakery for a recolour. Reused from ph-rangers (school.glb).

workplace.notes: Small sandstone/red-brick workshop with a tall brick chimney at the back corner and a glowing arched furnace opening at +Z. Reused from clean-flow (foundry.glb). Low poly (4.7k tris).

workplace-bakery.notes: Cream sandstone shop with a red-and-white striped awning and bread shelves at +Z, clay oven on the +X side. Reused from clean-flow (bakery.glb). Low poly (4.6k tris).

clinic.notes: Round white clinic with mint trim, glossy sky-blue dome with a big red HEART (no red cross, no text) facing +Z over the blue double door, round windows, potted plant, entrance ramp.

townhouse.role: Plaza dressing: narrow two-storey town house
townhouse.notes: Peach plaster walls, orange-red tile roof with chimney, blue shutters, flower box with red geraniums. QUIRK: the green front door and flower box face -X (not +Z); rotate by -PI/2 about Y to face +Z.

house.role: Plaza dressing: small one-storey stone house
house.notes: Limestone block house, flat parapet roof with a domed rooftop water tank, turquoise arched door at +Z, blue-shuttered window, red geranium pot, vine-covered pergola beam. Reused from ph-rangers (house.glb, via landscape-detective).

fountain.notes: Three-tier stone fountain on a round grassy base with small flowers. Water is baked into the texture; add a procedural water sheet/particles if you want motion.

bench.notes: Wooden slats, ornate black metal arms. The gallery export was NOT normalised (about 98 units wide); a scaled 'root' node (x0.010227) was added in assets-src/tools/normalize.mjs, so it now matches the others. Seat faces +Z (length along X).

boat.role: Migration level dressing: harbour fishing boat
boat.notes: Red wooden trawler with white wheelhouse and one mast (height includes the mast). The bow points -X: rotate by PI about Y to sail toward +X. Reused from storm-proof (boat.glb).

locomotive.role: Migration level dressing: toy steam engine
locomotive.notes: Teal boiler with brass bands, red cab and big red wheels, on a short piece of track. Smokebox/front points -X, cab at +X. QUIRK: the chimney is a stack of calendar pages with a puff of steam (from its original game); reads fine as a toy chimney. Reused from tilt-world (locomotive.glb).

carriage.role: Migration level dressing: passenger carriage behind the locomotive
carriage.notes: Teal-blue carriage with brass trim, rounded red roof, four cream-framed windows per side, end platforms with railings, red spoked wheels, on a short rail piece. Length along X; couple it to the locomotive's +X (cab) end. With the suggested heights the two get almost the same scale (about 4.7 vs 4.6), so they read as the same length.

plane.role: Migration level dressing: small propeller plane
plane.notes: Red vintage single-engine plane with fixed landing gear, nose/propeller at +Z, wingspan along X. Decimated from 961k to 26.8k tris (Blender merge-by-distance + collapse decimate). For a spinning propeller, overlay a translucent disc at the nose; the propeller is part of the single mesh.

tree-olive.notes: Gnarled olive with silver-green canopy. Reused from ph-rangers (olive.glb). Randomise yaw and scale 0.85-1.15 when scattering.

tree-cypress.notes: Columnar Mediterranean cypress. Very cheap (4.8k tris), good for instancing. Reused from ph-rangers (cypress.glb).

tree-palm.notes: Fan palm with a small sandy base. Reused from halfpipe-joule (palm.glb); same file as tilt-world's palm (identical sha256).
